The DFA state transitions may not be properly distinguishing between comment characters and valid tokens, especially when the input is transformed (e.g., case changes, comment removal).
The `next_state` function may not be correctly identifying the state transitions, leading to incorrect token recognition and processing.
The `check_delimiter` function may not be properly identifying valid delimiters, leading to incorrect token classification.
